chunks: And you love wealth with a great love.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the love of wealth in Surah Al-Fajr?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Fajr (70:20) characterizes the people of 'Ad by their insatiable greed, which blinded them to divine signs and led to their destruction. It serves as a profound ethical warning against the idolatry of wealth (hubb al-mal), illustrating how excessive attachment to materialism corrupts the soul and distracts from spiritual remembrance.
